t: Grow a bean: a hands-on science activity
d: Watch roots and shoots appear, then draw the changes in your own bean diary. For ages 6–12; includes materials, steps and a printable image sheet.

t: Make a shape collage: a hands-on art activity
d: Tear, arrange and layer colourful paper to make a picture that is entirely your own. For ages 3–8; includes materials, steps and a printable image sheet.

t: Make a repeating pattern: a hands-on maths activity
d: Turn big paper shapes into repeating patterns and challenge someone to find your rule. For ages 3–8; includes materials, steps and a printable image sheet.

d: Invent a character, give them a problem and draw their way to an ending. For ages 6–12; includes materials, steps and a printable image sheet.

d: Test how folding changes a paper bridge, then improve your design with a fair comparison. For ages 6–12; includes materials, steps and a printable image sheet.

t: Sink or Float?: a hands-on science activity
d: Test everyday objects in water, record what happens and redesign a foil boat. For ages 4–7; includes materials, steps and a printable image sheet.

t: My Weather Journal: a hands-on science activity
d: Observe the sky, keep a weather diary, choose an outfit and build a toy shelter. For ages 4–7; includes materials, steps and a printable image sheet.

t: Alphabet & Letter Sounds for 3 Year Olds
d: Explore A–Z letters with your preschooler using colorful alphabet cards, beginning sounds, printable letter sheets to solve and easy activities to try at home.

t: Numbers & Counting 1–10 for 3 Year Olds
d: Count from 1 to 10 with your preschooler using colorful number cards, printable number sheets to solve, number ordering and simple activities to try at home.

t: Shapes & Patterns for 3 Year Olds
d: Play with circles, squares, stars and simple repeating patterns with your preschooler using colorful shape cards, printable shape sheets to solve and pattern play to try at home.

t: Colors & Color Mixing for 3 Year Olds
d: Learn colors with your preschooler using color splash and picture cards, a rainbow to explore, printable color sheets to solve and color hunts to try at home.

t: Opposites & Comparing for 3 Year Olds
d: Play with opposites and your preschooler: six opposite pairs on real picture cards, printable opposite sheets to compare at the table, bigger-taller-longer word play and household hunts to try at home.

t: Animals & Their Sounds for 3 Year Olds
d: Play with animals and your preschooler: twelve picture cards with real animal sounds to hear, printable animal sheets to solve at the table, off-screen barnyard play and a print view — no scores.

t: Body Parts & My Five Senses for 3 Year Olds
d: Learn body parts and the five senses with your preschooler: twenty-four picture cards, printable body sheets to solve at the table, sense play and off-screen activities — no scores.

t: Fruits & Vegetables for 3 Year Olds

t: Magic Color Lab — a Paint Mixing Game for 3 Year Olds
d: Mix colors like paint with your preschooler: tap two splashes — red, yellow or blue — watch them combine into orange, green or purple, then try real paint off screen. No scores.

t: Animal Sound Safari — an Animal Sound Game for 3 Year Olds
d: Play at the animal playground with your 3-year-old: tap six animals to hear their real sounds, guess who made each sound, find the right animal and copy their moves — then play it off screen. No scores.
